providedIn: `root`

Methods:

Each status request has its own timeout and retry limit. Authorization errors propagate. Other exhausted requests and the overall deadline emit a terminal unknown status so the caller can offer a status retry.

### PdfService

File: `src/app/core/services/pdf.service.ts`
providedIn: `root`

Properties:
- `dateTimePipe: unknown = inject(DateTimePipe)`

Methods:
- `cjaName(raw?: string): string`
- `cleanPart(v: unknown): string` — Treat common placeholder tokens as empty; trim/collapse spaces.
- `continuousApplicationContents(entry: PdfList['entries']['number']): string`
- `continuousNotes(entry: PdfList['entries']['number']): string`
- `dedupeParts(parts: string[]): string[]` — De-duplicate consecutive tokens (case-insensitive).
- `drawContinuousEntry(entry: PdfList['entries']['number'], entryIndex: number, drawTwoColRow: DrawContinuousTwoColumnRow, drawFullRow: DrawContinuousFullRow): void`
- `drawContinuousFullRowPart(doc: JsPDFLike, labelLines: string[], valueLines: string[], layout: typeof CONTINUOUS_APPLICATION_LIST_LAYOUT, y: number): void`
- `drawContinuousListHeader(data: PdfList, raw: unknown, drawTwoColRow: DrawContinuousTwoColumnRow): void`
- `fallbackText(v?: string, fallback: string = '—'): string`
- `fileSafe(s?: string): string` — Filename-safe text.
- `firstTitleToken(s?: unknown): string` — Titles like "Mr, Mrs" → pick first meaningful token.
- `formatContactDetails(cd: unknown, dob?: string): string` — Formats supported contact-detail field names for printable party text. Address fields are joined on one line; date of birth and available contact methods follow on separate lines.
- `formatParty(p: unknown): string` — Person/organisation display name with placeholder cleanup.
- `generateContinuousApplicationListsPdf(dtos: unknown[], isClosed: boolean): Promise<void>` — Saves multiple application lists in a continuous landscape PDF. Most rows use two columns with wrapping values. Long full-width values can split across pages with a continued label. New pages receive a fresh header. The closed-list flag selects the document header text.
- `generatePagedApplicationListPdf(dto: unknown, opts?: { crestUrl?: string }): Promise<void>` — Saves application list entries in a paged portrait PDF. Each entry starts on a new page, and long entry content can continue beneath a repeated header on another page. An optional crest is loaded once for all headers (in this application we always render '/assets/govuk-crest.png'). Failure to load or draw it does not stop PDF generation.
- `generateStandardApplicantsPdf(dto: StandardApplicantPrintDto): Promise<void>` — Saves a portrait report of standard applicants and any search criteria. Each applicant is rendered as a table that may move to another page; an absent DTO exits without creating a PDF.
- `getContinuousPageHeader(isClosed: boolean): string`
- `normalise(dto: unknown): PdfList` — Converts supported list and entry response shapes into the printable model. When several source fields represent the same value, the first nonempty candidate wins (for example, date before listDate and hearingDate ). Missing or malformed objects become empty printable fields which are then resolved as '–'.
- `renderContinuousApplicationLists(dataArr: PdfList[], dtos: unknown[], drawListDivider: function, drawTwoColRow: DrawContinuousTwoColumnRow, drawFullRow: DrawContinuousFullRow): void`
- `safeFormatDate(value: string | Date | undefined, format: "mediumDate" | "longDate" = 'mediumDate'): string | null`
- `standardApplicantSearchCriteria(criteria: unknown | null | undefined): string`
- `standardApplicantValue(applicant: StandardApplicantPrintDto['applicants']['number'], label: string): string`
- `toLinesPreserveBlanks(doc: JsPDFLike, text: string, valueWidth: number): string[]`
- `tryLoadImageAsDataUrl(url: string): Promise<string | null>`
- `uniqueFileSafePlaces(dataArr: PdfList[]): string[]`
